events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection of Chinese Contemporary Art
events.description: This exhibition showcases 35 bold and experimental artworks from 25 Chinese artists, capturing the spirit of 21st-century China through video, photography, painting, and sculpture. It interrogates authority, reclaims history, and reflects profound social change.

events.title: Cowboys & Country at Historic Rivermill
events.description: This monthly recurring event features country music in an authentic, intimate atmosphere at the historic Rivermill venue, attracting a community of regular attendees who love the genre.

events.title: Gold Coast Philippine Festival 2026
events.description: A vibrant, authentic cultural community event celebrating Filipino heritage with food, games, live traditional music, and dance performances. In 2026, the festival embarks on a 3-year cultural journey honouring the stories of the Philippines.

events.title: NaturallyGC – Botanical Watercolour Painting
events.description: Part of the NaturallyGC program, this creative workshop merges art-making with nature connection, ideal for curious, hands-on participants of all skill levels. Attendees will learn botanical watercolour techniques.

events.title: NaturallyGC – Birds of the Bush Photography Walk
events.description: A guided outdoor photography walk through native bushland, perfect for nature lovers and photographers of any skill level to practice bird photography and identification, as part of the NaturallyGC citizen science initiative.

events.title: NaturallyGC – Marine Science, Rescue and Rehabilitation (Presentation)
events.description: A free, intellectually stimulating presentation from marine science practitioners, discussing marine science, rescue, and rehabilitation efforts as part of the NaturallyGC program.

events.title: Gold Coast Whale & Ocean Festival
events.description: This free festival, organised by local NGO Humpbacks and Highrises, celebrates the ocean and its marine life. It features insights from leading researchers on local species like sharks, turtles, whales, dolphins, and dugongs.

events.title: Through My Eyes – Ep 1: Living with the Mentawai (Documentary Screening)
events.description: A documentary film screening exploring life with the Mentawai people of Indonesia, perfect for those interested in anthropology, adventure, and human behaviour.

events.title: Lessons in Disaster – Gold Coast
events.description: An intellectually-driven event examining various aspects of disaster, potentially covering natural catastrophes, systems failures, or historical events, for those with a curious mind.

events.title: NaturallyGC – Nature Journaling (Adults)
events.description: This workshop combines creative writing and drawing with time spent in nature, offering a reflective experience for adults to connect with their surroundings through journaling.

events.title: NaturallyGC – Sea Slug Citizen Science (Adults)
events.description: A hands-on marine citizen science activity where participants can get into the water, identify marine life, and contribute to real conservation data on sea slugs.

events.title: NaturallyGC – Springbrook Bushwalk
events.description: A guided rainforest walk through the scenic Springbrook National Park, offering an excellent outdoor adventure for those who love nature and the hinterland.

events.title: NaturallyGC – Marine Life of the Broadwater
events.description: Explore the rich marine ecosystems of the Broadwater with nature experts, ideal for ocean-curious minds interested in local marine life.

events.title: RESENHA 021 – Aniversário Do Cantor Vitinho | Gold Coast Edition
events.description: A live Brazilian music celebration with an energetic and culturally rich atmosphere, attracting a passionate community crowd interested in world music and Latin culture.
